limitations.reason: Haxe resolves every signature in a loaded module, so one mixed facade would let an unsupported native type poison otherwise supported declarations. Package.configure selects complete target-specific roots behind flight_hx, js+flight_esm, or cpp defines.

Non-scalar types and signatures require an explicit identity, lifetime, nullable/union, callback, and structural-owner mapping; generated C++ header presence alone is not a safe Haxe binding contract.
The current compile-proven native partition binds functions and Scene2D handles but no mutable/default runtime value exports.

flight-hx web/dual planning uses flight-compiler 804435ad89716bd3ddb8144e435adb0be6c9477b, while the pinned flight-cpp generated SDK was committed with 806d257d2f4100de745cc97340e61c2f301b0f24. Both revisions are recorded; shared Flight source identity and exact locators are reconciled without claiming compiler-revision equality.
SDL3/OpenGL hosting and the Scene2D ownership session are manifest-recorded flight-hx extensions, not claims of package-wide portable API parity.

refusals.detail: Unrelated generated functions in the header contain unresolved flight::Any conversions, comparisons, and indexing.
